name: HWStepGen
description: Stepper motor speed control for the ESP32 family. STEP pulses are generated by the LEDC peripheral, so the pulse rate is unaffected by CPU load. Supports ESP32, S2, S3, C3, C6, H2 and P4 on Arduino core 2.x and 3.x.
keywords: esp32, stepper, motor, ledc, pwm, driver, a4988, drv8825, tmc2209
